name: powerpages-traditional-site
description: Power Pages Traditional (non-code) site toolkit — skills for building, editing, integrating, and securing Power Pages sites on the enhanced Dataverse data model (mspp_* tables + powerpagecomponent): web pages, web templates, web files, server logic, Liquid, Web API, table permissions, security review, and cache flush. The traditional-site counterpart to Microsoft's code-site plugin.
